adverse_results: Two open-phase baseline probe versions reused one executable pathname. No closed artifact was changed, and physical continuity is not claimed for those two open-phase binaries.

Initial diagnostic setup assumed one serde_json library in the retained target; no command launched. The corrected selector uses the recorded all-feature build artifacts.

The first candidate confused ln(1+x) residuals with ln inputs. The unchanged all-feature log1p serialization regression caught the rejection of valid inputs. The rejected source, original incorrectly classified zero cases, failing output and oracle correction are retained. Zero is now explicitly required to succeed; existing tests and full-scale residuals remain unchanged.

Child decoding finishes before the parent is published.

qualification_this_checkpoint.representation: No public signature, wire schema, expression or object-layout change. Valid opaque operands remain accepted when no exact leaf proof is available. This guard rejects demonstrably invalid inputs; it does not certify arbitrary imported graphs.
qualification_this_checkpoint.resource_limits: The new guard performs a variant dispatch and exact leaf comparisons, without refinement, expression expansion or recursive proof search. Arbitrary coefficient length, import depth, total import work and graph domain validity are not internally bounded by this change; tests run under external containment.
